what_is_it.explanation: nanoGPT is a lightweight PyTorch implementation designed for training and finetuning medium-sized GPT models from scratch. It consists of a plain, readable codebase featuring a roughly 300-line training loop and a roughly 300-line model definition. It serves as a rewrite of minGPT, allowing developers to easily hack on, train new models, or load OpenAI GPT-2 weights.
